heroData.name: Mohammadrahil Nasardi
heroData.role: Data Science & Analytics | Machine Learning | GenAI (RAG & Federated Learning)
heroData.tagline: B.E. CSE (AI&ML) student at VTU with practical experience in Python, SQL, exploratory data analysis, predictive modeling, and intelligent agent pipelines. Seeking an entry-level Data Science or Data Analytics role to build data-driven solutions.

aboutData.heading: Empowering Decision Making through Data Analytics & Machine Learning
aboutData.paragraph1: I am a B.E. student specializing in Computer Science & Engineering (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning) at Jain College of Engineering and Research, VTU.
aboutData.paragraph2: My expertise spans exploratory data analysis (EDA), data cleaning, statistical modeling, feature engineering, and predictive ML systems. I also engineer modern AI solutions including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and multi-agent Federated Learning architectures using Python, SQL, TensorFlow, FastAPI, and Power BI.
aboutData.paragraph3: Whether it's uncovering pricing trends across thousands of dataset records or building real-time crop disease detection models, I focus on solving real-world problems with data-driven precision.

focusData.title: Event Coordinator — Savishkar 2025
focusData.description: Spearheaded operational leadership for the flagship "Seconds Ka Tashan" competition during Savishkar 2025. Coordinated team logistics, volunteer workflows, participant tracking, and venue execution across four high-intensity competitive elimination rounds.
